profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Airbnb
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with over 14+ Years of experience in software development. Self-driven and passionate about what I do, always learning and moving forward with the best development technologies and practices.

I’ve had the fortune of working within several environments and technologies from small companies to large enterprises, as well as technologies from ASP to Node.js.

Some notable projects, the design of a new enterprise level application for Walmart International, the redesign of the mobile site for Samsclub.com and the presidential campaign of Mitt Romney (Mobile App, Facebook Apps and Web site updates), also fully responsive sites Meadjohnson.com.cn, cornerbakerycafe.com, among others.

Strong knowledge of programming best practices. Great communication skills, able to work on a team environment and solo if required. Proven leadership skills on large and small projects alike.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working as a Senior Software Engineer with a focus on Web
- As part of the Checkout team, currently focusing on rethinking the flow to make it the best possible for our customers.
- Previously part of the Users team, working on on boarding customers to the platform.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on the growth and engagement org, working as a full stack engineer with the JavaScript ecosystem, creating API’s with Node.js on the AWS platform as well as cross site components with React, Next.js and GraphQL.

Part of the Registration and APIs team we are in charge of several cross site functionality features such as registration, Authentication and Security as well as Save and Share properties, profile and saved homes pages among others.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
I’ve had the opportunity to work on the B2B team, creating new products for the self-serve platform, that has grown more than 200% year over year, as well as tools for customers to manage their Glassdoor profile and products.

Functioning as a reference for JavaScript and React, I was one of the 2 main implementers of this new technology with in Glassdoor, focusing heavily on code and product quality, helping to create and enforce best practices for the technology such as Unit testing and conde linting. Also part of an initiative to migrate from JSP to Node.js that is ongoing.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working on the Home Page and Verticals group as Senior Software Engineer at one of the most recognized brands on Internet, part of the common experiences team creating components to be used across the company, focusing on native advertisement.

With a great focus on performance as well as compatibility and accessibility, we have to take under consideration the all kinds of customers and their circumstances. Using the latest technologies and trends Node.js, React.js, HTML(5) among others.

positions.title: Sr. Developer
positions.description:
Senior Web Developer at an award winner digital agency, using cutting edge technologies to create Applications with the highest standards for web and mobile. Working with international customers such as Walmart/SAMS Club, Mead-Johnson, and nationwide brands as Corner Bakery, Value City Furniture, among others.

I was lead and responsible for the Front-End development on the Mead-Johnson china site to be used as template for all international markets, a fully responsive site with cross browser compatibility concerns down to IE8, responsible for the Front-End development of the Walmart Corporate Brand Center redesign. Participated on several mobile micro site efforts for Walmart and Others. Responsible for updates and maintenance to the SAMS.com mobile site both on the front and back end, expert on .Net development (SOA, MVC, Entity-Framework, etc.) as well as knowledgeable on PHP. Part of Mitt Romney's presidential campaign team in charge of developing Mobile Apps (Flash Platform), Facebook Apps and web site, both on the Front and Back-End. 

I as made part of the Rapid Innovations Team (RND and Swat). Praised for my versatility I had the opportunity to work on innovative technologies to push the market like Microsoft Kinect, the Corona SDK, PhoneGap, Adobe Flash and Flex, among others. Always exploring the newest tools and standards on the market to add value to the customer.

positions.title: Technical Leader
positions.description: Support and Create applications for the ISD International Wal-Mart Division, I created the design of an entirely new architecture based on .Net for a new multinational and multilingual system for the Accounts Receivable area of Wal-Mart International. Leader of one of the biggest teams on the area with up to 10 developers. Coordinating the relationship with the customers. Working with scrum and waterfall. Involved on the entire life-cycle from requirements, design, estimate, develop, testing and deploy.

positions.title: Test Programmer, IT Manager
positions.description: Started on the CAM department as a Test programmer using Frontline Genesis 2000 to generate the program data for the testing, becoming a net-list analysis expert supporting all test and CAM personal. Became IT Manager after 6 months, supporting all PC related equipment giving me the opportunity to learn about the entire Printed Circuit Board (PCB) process, supporting different types of specific industry equipment, leaning about different hardware and operating systems, several versions of Windows and Linux. Maintain configure and support all network related equipment as well as desk support and training.

positions.title: Lead Programmer
positions.description:
One of the company startup employees since the beginning of my bachelor’s degree I got involved on the actual field, reviewing, training and supporting all new employees that arrived, creating complex and complete web based applications on ASP for local business like retailers, medics, home security, among others.

Tools: Microsoft Access, SQL Server, ASP, Microsoft Visual Studio 2003, Macromedia Dreamweaver, SQL Server, HTML, JavaScript, CSS.

projects.title: Mitt Romney for President
projects.description: I was able to apply my agency experience and technology prowess to provide extremely fast results on high-visibility projects with tight deadlines. My team and were responsible for the rapid execution of the Romney Ryan iPhone and Android applications as well as social media applications built on the Facebook platform.
